findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "pricing" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: instant_term_sheet_requirements · Private data: request_instant_term_sheet · Public sink: instant_term_sheet_requirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: instant_term_sheet_requirements · Private data: request_instant_term_sheet · Public sink: instant_term_sheet_requirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "request_instant_term_sheet" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
